name: Laurea University of Applied Sciences
summary: Applied-sciences university in Espoo and Vantaa; six English bachelor's for 2027 in business, service, nursing, social services and online IT.

ib.text: An IB Diploma makes you eligible. Studyinfo lists the International UAS Exam or Laurea's own exam for each programme; the full 2027 criteria are not yet published.

programmes.name: Business Management
programmes.about: Business for a data-driven market: digital tools for financial and market insight, digital marketing and financial management, with a specialisation in Corporate Financial Management or Digital Marketing.
programmes.overview: You study business communication, marketing, leadership, data analytics, financial management, sales development and sustainability, and choose a track in either Corporate Financial Management or Digital Marketing. Teaching follows the Learning by Developing approach: authentic projects with companies, up to two work placements, and a final development project usually done with a partner company. Industry certifications from Microsoft, Google and SAS are built into the coursework, and double-degree options exist with partners in Austria and Belgium. Graduates become digital marketing specialists, financial planners, business developers, project managers or entrepreneurs.
programmes.ib: International UAS Exam, as listed on Studyinfo; 2027 criteria not yet published. Leppävaara campus.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published. In 2026 Laurea chose by the International UAS Exam, not on IB grades.

programmes.name: Service Experience Management
programmes.about: Hospitality, events, food and beverage and tourism, learned through practical projects with companies and service design, combining academic study with the skills the industry expects.
programmes.overview: You combine hospitality management, service design, and leadership and business, then add a focus in Innovating Food Services, Tourism Service Development or Event Service Production. Service design methods are taught through classroom studies and working-life projects, with team projects on real business challenges and shifts in BarLaurea, the teaching restaurant, where you work both as staff and as process planner. A work placement and a thesis showing workplace expertise complete the degree, and study visits abroad add an international angle. Graduates work as project managers, event producers, restaurant managers and service design planners, or continue to a master's in service innovation and design.
programmes.ib: International UAS Exam, as listed on Studyinfo; full 2027 criteria not yet published. Leppävaara campus.
programmes.selectionNote: Studyinfo lists the International UAS Exam as the selection method for 2027; other criteria are still to be announced. Not decided on IB grades.

programmes.name: Cyber Security, Business Information Technology
programmes.about: Technical, advisory and management skills in cyber security (networks, information security management, security technologies) on a business IT base, studied fully online.
programmes.overview: You learn to secure systems, analyse risks and prevent threats, alongside project management, communication, problem-solving and business administration. Teaching follows Laurea's Learning by Developing model, with hands-on projects, real development assignments, laboratory and simulation environments for testing vulnerabilities, and workshops with business experts; PwC and Microsoft appear among partners. The curriculum uses the competency frameworks that security professionals work with internationally, and you collaborate with students from other fields. Graduates work as information security specialists, threat analysts, systems developers, security coordinators or cybersecurity consultants, or continue to a master's.
programmes.ib: International UAS Exam, as listed on Studyinfo; 2027 criteria not yet published. Online studies only in 2027.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published. In 2026 Laurea chose Business IT students by the International UAS Exam, not on IB grades.

programmes.name: Developing Digital Services, Business Information Technology
programmes.about: IT, business and design combined for building digital services, studied fully online through real development projects with tutor support.
programmes.overview: You study business fundamentals, programming and software development basics, databases, infrastructure, information security, service design methods and analytics, from requirements analysis through application design, implementation and testing. You choose between the Cloud Developer and Digital Service Designer tracks. Teaching is online, with webinars, workshops, project work and optional campus sessions, plus two practical placements and a final thesis or project with a working-life organisation; Industry 4.0 projects touch robotics, IoT, data analytics and VR. Graduates work as IT consultants, web, mobile and application developers, data analysts, product owners and project managers.
programmes.ib: International UAS Exam, as listed on Studyinfo; 2027 criteria not yet published. Online studies only in 2027.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published. In 2026 Laurea chose Business IT students by the International UAS Exam, not on IB grades.

programmes.name: Nursing
programmes.about: Registered-nurse training in English with Finnish support and 90 ECTS of clinical placements, meeting EU requirements so you can work as a nurse across the EU.
programmes.overview: You study nursing theory together with clinical practice in surgical, internal medicine, mental health, paediatric and rehabilitation settings, including safe medication handling, ethical decision-making and client-centred support, with Finnish courses geared to nursing. Skills are first practised in simulation and then applied with supervised patients across several placements; the thesis is a development project, usually with a healthcare partner. A dual-degree option with Nazareth University lets you spend a year in the United States. Graduates work as registered nurses in hospitals, clinics, home care, occupational health, mental health and public health, or in humanitarian roles.
programmes.ib: Requires Finnish at B1 and English at B2. Laurea's own entrance exam; Studyinfo says 2027 details are to be announced.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published. In 2026 Nursing had Laurea's own entrance exam at Tikkurila; Finnish B1 is required.

programmes.name: Social Services
programmes.about: Social services work taught in English with Finnish built in, functionally bilingual, with three internships worth 45 ECTS; blended study at Tikkurila.
programmes.overview: You study working with clients in social services, service systems, social work methods and the development of client-oriented services, across the lifespan from children and families to older people, mental health, substance abuse and disability. Training is practical, with three internships of at least ten weeks in different settings, projects with organisations, and a development project usually done with a service provider, NGO or municipality. Study is blended, mixing campus sessions with online learning. Graduates work as social counsellors, family and youth workers, school counsellors or specialists in mental health and substance abuse, or continue to a master's in global health and crisis management.
programmes.ib: Requires Finnish at B1 and English at B2. Laurea's own entrance exam; 2027 details to be announced. Blended learning at Tikkurila.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published. In 2026 Social Services had Laurea's own entrance exam at Tikkurila; Finnish B1 is required.

notes: Safety, Security and Risk Management is not open in the January 2027 round, and neither are the campus versions of Cyber Security and Developing Digital Services.
Nursing and Social Services are taught in English but both require Finnish at B1 when you apply.
Laurea has not yet published its 2027 deadlines for IB predicted grades or final grades.
